steps.say: The mixed numbers have different wholes, so turn each into an improper fraction over the same bottom [[den]]: $[[w1]] \frac{[[n1]]}{[[den]]} = \frac{[[a_improper]]}{[[den]]}$ and $[[w2]] \frac{[[n2]]}{[[den]]} = \frac{[[b_improper]]}{[[den]]}$.
Now the bottoms match, so [[op]] the tops: [[a_improper]] [[op]] [[b_improper]] = [[result]], over [[den]].
